q: Waves are classified as transverse and longitudinal waves depending on ____ of particles in the medium through which they propagate.
e: Waves are classified as transverse and longitudinal waves depending on vibration of particles in the medium through which they propagate. In a longitudinal wave the particles shake along the travel, as in sound.

q: If the displacements of particles of the medium are ____ to the direction of the wave, such a wave is called a transverse wave.
e: If the displacements of particles of the medium are perpendicular to the direction of the wave, such a wave is called a transverse wave. In a transverse wave the particles shake at right angles to the travel.

q: Waves in a vibrating string are ____.
e: Waves in a vibrating string are transverse waves. In a transverse wave the particles shake at right angles to the travel.

q: Light waves and other electromagnetic waves are also ____.
e: Light waves and other electromagnetic waves are also transverse waves. In a transverse wave the particles shake at right angles to the travel.

q: If the displacements of particles of medium are ____ to the direction of the waves, such a wave is called a longitudinal wave.
e: If the displacements of particles of medium are parallel to the direction of the waves, such a wave is called a longitudinal wave. In a longitudinal wave the particles shake along the travel, as in sound.

q: Compressional waves in a slinky coiled spring and sound waves are ____.
e: Compressional waves in a slinky coiled spring and sound waves are longitudinal waves. In a longitudinal wave the particles shake along the travel, as in sound.
